newsitem.title: INDIA: GE unit pays 53.5 rupee/shr for SRF Finance.
newsitem.headline: GE unit pays 53.5 rupee/shr for SRF Finance.

text.p: India's SRF Ltd said on Tuesday that GE Capital Services, a unit of U.S.-based General Electric Co, would pay 53.50 rupees per share to buy a controlling stake in SRF Finance Ltd.
SRF Ltd said in a statement released in the Indian capital that it would use the approximately 480 million rupees raised from the sale of its 50.5 percent stake in SRF Finance to reduce its debt.
GE Capital Services had announced earlier on Tuesday that it had reached agreement with SRF Ltd to buy a majority stake in SRF Finance.
GE Capital Services had also said that after acquiring the majority, it would launch a public offer for the remaining shares of the company at the same price it had negotiated with SRF Ltd.
"The bid price received from GE Capital is 53.50 rupees per equity share," SRF's statement said.
SRF Ltd vice chairman Arun Bharat Ram said his firm would use the approximately 480 million rupees from the sale to reduce debt.
SRF makes nylon tyre cords, fabrics and fluorchemicals, and also has some interests engineering plastics, polyester films and eye lenses.
GE Capital is a diversified financial services company based in Mauritius.
